hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for every site (Electricity Hookup '50', Water Hookup 'Y' on all electric sites; e.g. https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5681&parkId=552902) + the park notes on every site page ('There are no sewer hookups on any campsites. There is a dump station conveniently located near the entrance to the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The booking site lists 147 sites (the park page says 158): 85 with 50-amp electric and water in Loops 1, 2, 3 and 5, and 62 without hookups in Loops 2, 4 and 5. Ten are walk-in tent sites (Loop 2 sites 60-64; Loop 4 sites 117, 120, 124, 128 and 131). Seven pull-throughs; listed driveways run 35-135 ft.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Holly Point offers 158 campsites total, 89 with water and 50/30-amp electric hookups') + ReserveAmerica site list and every Holly Point site page (Site Access, Driveway Entry, Driveway Length, Electricity Hookup), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Both Holly Point and Rolling View have a dump station'; 'Bathhouses are centrally located in each camping loop'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites can be booked for today and up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552902 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; Business Rules for Holiday Weekends: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend', '1 night Minimum Stay on holiday weekend if the booking dates within 14 Days before Arrival Date'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites without hookups $30 a night and electric/water sites $40, each including the $3-a-night service fee that the booking site adds to its $27 / $37 camping fee (charged on in-person bookings too). Seniors 62+, veterans and military members get $6 off a night with ID at check-in. No out-of-state rate; federal passes are not accepted. Cancelling costs $15 per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('RV with electric and water hookups $40'; 'Tent, trailer, or RV site with no hookups $30'; 'All prices listed on this website page include the $3 service fee'; 'A $3 service fee is charged for all reservations, including those made in-person'; 'Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass') + ReserveAmerica price breakdowns https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5729&parkId=552902 (Loop 4 site 110, 2026-11-17: 'Camping Fees (1 night) $27.00 Per Night') and https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/falls-lake-state-recreation-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=5681&parkId=552902 (Loop 3 site 077, 2026-11-17: '$37.00 Per Night') ('Reservation Fees $3.00 Per Night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass, or passes for other states'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Added 50-amp electric and water with no sewer, 147 sites (85 electric) with pull-throughs, dump station, ReserveAmerica booking (6-month window, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days), $30 / $40 rates with the $3 service fee included and the senior/military $6 discount. The construction closure (status, manual) stands. Not set: season, because the 2026 schedule is the construction schedule (Loops 2-4 open November 16 to December 1, Loops 1 and 5 closed); showers not named.
flags: Still temporarily closed for wastewater construction (status unchanged): Loops 2, 3 and 4 reopen November 16, 2026; Loops 1 and 5 are 'Closed for Construction' with no date. The 2026 schedule shows Loops 2 and 4 closing again December 1, 2026.
Site count: ReserveAmerica lists 147 Holly Point sites; ncparks.gov says 158 (89 electric vs 85 on the booking site).
ReserveAmerica's 'Distance to Body of Water' reads 2500 ft for every Loop 1 site, which the map does not bear out; not used.
Registry state:NC min_stay waiver says 7 days; ReserveAmerica's holiday rule for Falls Lake and Jordan Lake says 14 days. Recorded 14 on all six.
